# Bonesupport kan dubblas – förvaltaren som vågar gå sin egen väg

**Feed**: placerapodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Placerarpodden interviews Erik Bertilsson, manager of the Lancelot Sverige fund, a concentrated stock-picker who meets company management and deviates heavily from index. He is strongly bullish on his top holding Bonesupport, which he thinks can double within three years. He also argues for Camurus (NET phase 3 readout and Eli Lilly partnership), Asmodee (cheap despite a rally) and Electrolux Professional (recently added, about 9x EBIT). He sees many low-valued Swedish small/mid caps worth picking individually, but is cautious on the small-cap index as a whole and on real estate, and says large caps are somewhat expensive.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BONEX — Bonesupport | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Largest fund holding; guest sees a good chance the stock doubles within 3 years, above previous peaks.

#### Reasoning

Guest view (fund manager): growth above 30%, EBIT margin about 30% heading to 40%+, US reimbursement codes secured, new clinical studies, strong cash flow funding buybacks. Weakness blamed on the medtech sector and a short seller whose claims he says have not held up. Users of the product have been uniformly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth slows materially
- if short-seller claims about efficacy were validated
- if margin expansion toward 40% stalls
- if the US reimbursement position deteriorates

> *"jag tycker att det finns goda möjligheter att det står väsentligt högre och över tidigare toppar"*

---

### 🟢 CAMX — Camurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Cheap on the existing business (well under 20x ex-R&D); phase 3 NET readout and Lilly obesity partnership add optionality.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: existing business (Buvidal/Brixadi, acromegaly) grows about 20% a year at a 60% operating margin and trades well under 20x earnings excluding R&D. The NET phase 3 readout (late 2026/early 2027) could open a multi-billion-dollar market against a market cap of about SEK 30bn. Royalties from the Lilly obesity collaboration are an extra long-dated option.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the NET phase 3 study fails
- if the Eli Lilly collaboration is terminated
- if Buvidal/Brixadi growth stalls

> *"Jag tycker inte heller man betalar speciellt mycket för det i aktien idag."*

---

### 🟢 ASMDEE-B — Asmodee | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Second-largest holding; still cheap at about 12x EBIT and 6-7% FCF yield despite being up about 60% YTD.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: strong European distribution position in board and trading card games, strong own brands, and a history of good acquisitions. The rally came from earnings upgrades, not a higher multiple. He expects growth to slow rather than collapse (5-8% organic plus M&A), so the valuation gap to serial acquirers (about 3% FCF yield) should narrow.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the trading card game boom reverses into a sharp decline
- if organic growth turns negative
- if the valuation re-rates toward serial-acquirer multiples

> *"Skulle man ta en liten del av det där gapet så är det klart att då finns det fortfarande bra uppsida även om aktien har gått väldigt bra i år."*

---

### 🟢 EPRO-B — Electrolux Professional | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Just added to the position; about 9x EBIT, stable cash flows, new CEO; 'a stable company that is far too cheap'.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: beaten down in the weak small-cap market despite strong market positions (especially professional laundry) and good-quality earnings. A new CEO and past product investment could lift growth and margins. He thinks little is needed for a re-rating once the business stabilises.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth keeps weakening
- if margins fail to recover
- if the new CEO's strategy disappoints

> *"ett stabilt bolag, som är alldeles för billigt"*

---
